def ik(self, pf, seed):
        """Solve arm IK for palm pose pf[:7] (fingers pf[7:] appended). seed: a runtime-order config.

        Returns a (1, ndof) tensor [arm(narm) + fingers] or None on failure.
        """
        r = self.arm_ik.solve_single(
            Pose.from_list(list(pf[:7])),
            seed_config=seed.view(1, 1, -1)[..., :self.arm_ik.kinematics.dof],
            retract_config=seed.view(1, -1)[:, :self.arm_ik.kinematics.dof])
        if not r.success:
            return None
        arm = r.solution.squeeze(1)[..., :C.PROFILE.narm]
        fingers = self.ta.to_device(np.asarray(pf[7:], np.float32)).view(1, -1)
        return torch.cat([arm, fingers], dim=-1)

def transform_pose(pose7, ox, oy, gamma, cxy):
    """Rigid transform: rotate by gamma about world-Z through (cxy,*), then translate (ox,oy)."""
    rzq = rz_quat(gamma); R = t3d.quaternions.quat2mat(rzq)
    p = np.asarray(pose7[:3], float).copy()
    p[:2] -= cxy; p = R @ p; p[:2] += cxy; p[:2] += [ox, oy]
    q = t3d.quaternions.qmult(rzq, np.asarray(pose7[3:7], float))
    return np.concatenate([p, q, np.asarray(pose7[7:])]) if len(pose7) > 7 else np.concatenate([p, q])

def shifted_grasp_qpos(array):
    output = np.asarray(array).copy()
    output[..., 2] += C.TABLE_TOP_Z
    return output

probeBasis.method: Static rigid transforms reconstructed from the hash-matched template, scene quaternion, frozen generator formulas and fixed A/C XY; no IK, planning, physics or GPU execution.
probeBasis.coordinateFrame: Original G3 coordinates with unchanged robot reference; WXYZ quaternions; metres. These are solver target inputs, not measured achieved positions.
probeBasis.anchorDerivation: C_REACH_BOUND.anchor_world_xyz minus [base_delta_x,base_delta_y,0]; same fixed arm anchor in the unchanged robot reference for A and C.
probeBasis.pregraspExtraAssumption: Reconstruction uses frozen PREGRASP_EXTRA default 0; actual process did not retain a full environment dump.

limits: Native summary counts are observed stdout. Per-candidate all-None attribution follows from all 29 rejects being pregrasp_ik, 348=29×12, zero other rejection counts, and the frozen control flow; it is not a newly added per-probe trace.
planner.ik None means result.success was false; retained evidence does not distinguish pose residual, joint limits, table/self collision, or solver convergence for individual probes.
No per-probe residuals, closest collision pairs, or accepted A probe gamma were logged. Native g1 data from later successful execution is not an IK diagnostic trace.
Pregrasp IK targets constrain palm position and quaternion. A short anchor-to-target distance alone does not prove a probe is feasible.
The hypothetical gamma grid differs from the fixed actual initial gamma. Prescreen acceptance alone does not prove that the exact trial initial pose or complete grasp will succeed.
